provenance: Kenney Casino Audio / Music Jingles (CC0), Willem Hunt Coin Drop / SoundBible (Public Domain), combined with original procedural composition and synthesis. Source files, licenses and per-cue layers are preserved.

sources.processing: Original files above are unmodified. Generator decodes with ffmpeg, trims silence, downmixes to mono, filters, speed/pitch-shifts, envelopes, pans and mixes into original synthesized compositions. Every output cue records actual source layers and SHA-256.
